title: Erdős #1011 (OQ-01) — Mantel's Theorem: the Triangle (r=2) Case, Axiom-Free

problemStatement.formal: ∀ (V : Type) [Fintype V] (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj], G.CliqueFree 3 → G.edgeFinset.card ≤ Fintype.card V ^ 2 / 4
problemStatement.plain: Discharge the triangle base case of Erdős #1011: prove Mantel's theorem (a triangle-free graph on n vertices has at most ⌊n²/4⌋ edges, sharply) axiom-free, converting the parent file's turan_theorem axiom into a theorem.
whyMatters: Mantel's theorem is the r=2 base case of the chromatic-triangle threshold f_r(n) studied by Erdős #1011; proving it removes one of the parent's five axioms.

proven: Mantel's bound #edges ≤ n²/4 for triangle-free graphs
Sharpness for even n via turanGraph n 2

Axiom elimination: discharges the parent's turan_theorem (triangle base case) as a theorem
insights: Triangle-free = CliqueFree 3; no-triangle is the r=2 case of K_{r+1}-free. SimpleGraph.CliqueFree.card_edgeFinset_le at r=2 IS Mantel's theorem — a specialization of existing Mathlib, not a new proof.

Mathlib's Turán bound carries exact integer corrections (n²−(n%r)²)(r−1)/(2r) + (n%r).choose 2; at r=2 the binomial term is 0 (n%2 < 2) and the subtraction only lowers the bound, so ⌊n²/4⌋ follows by Nat-division monotonicity + omega for the modular side conditions.
Sharpness is exhibited by a concrete witness (turanGraph n 2) with a computed exact edge count, not asserted — for even n it equals n²/4 exactly.
Docker-down host verification (lake env lean against prebuilt oleans) + #print axioms audit is sufficient to certify a single Mathlib-only file as verified-original.
